__________
No. 1 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Virtual Asset Business Act, No. 24 of
2022.
[ 17th March, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

4
No. 1 ] Virtual Asset Business (Amendment) Act [ 2025
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Virtual Asset Business
(Amendment) Act, 2025.
Interpretation
2. In this Act, “principal Act” means the Virtual Asset Business
Act, No. 24 of 2022.
Amendment of section 2
3. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended in the definition of
the word “person”, by inserting immediately after the word “includes”
the words “a natural person” and a comma.
Amendment of section 4
4. Section 4 of the principal Act is amended by inserting
immediately after subsection (6) the following new subsection (6A) —
“(6A) The Authority shall monitor a virtual asset business to
determine compliance with this Act.”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 25th day of February,
2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 27th day of February, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
